sentences.text:
Opposite Parties on 27 February, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77037066/
1 upon him for the conviction recorded under Section 376 of IPC by the learned CJM-cum-ASJ,
Koraput, Jeypore in C.T. No.41 of 2012 and his release on bail pending disposal of this Criminal Revision.

2. Heard.
3.

On the basis of the custody certificate on record which was submitted on 03.08.2025, it is seen that the Petitioner is in custody for a period five years, two months and 26 days and in the meanwhile another six months has elapsed.
Hence, the Petitioner has undergone custody for about five years and nine months out of the sentence imposed i.e. seven years.
4. Referring to the same, the learned counsel for the Petitioner seeks bail.

5. Considering the period of incarceration and the docket congestion of this Court, the revision being of the year 2025, this Court directs that the Petitioner shall be released on bail on such terms and conditions as deemed just and proper by the learned CJM-cum- ASJ, Koraput, Jeypore in C.T. No.41 of 2012 pending disposal of the Criminal Revision.
6. I.A is accordingly disposed of.
7. U.C.C. in course of the day.
